selected_evidence.requirement: node1 configured with private-network interface (eth1) and source NAT masquerade rule for 10.50.50.0/24 via eth0
selected_evidence.summary: VyOS eth1 address set to 10.50.50.254/24 and NAT source rule 10 (masquerade, source 10.50.50.0/24, outbound eth0) committed and saved; show nat confirms the rule is present in running config

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 addressed on the private network with persistent config
selected_evidence.summary: Created ifcfg-eth1 files (BOOTPROTO=static, ONBOOT=yes) and brought interfaces up: node2=10.50.50.11/24, node3=10.50.50.12/24

selected_evidence.requirement: processes on node2/node3 can reach the internet through node1's NAT
selected_evidence.summary: From both node2 and node3, ping to 1.1.1.1 via node1 (10.50.50.254) succeeded and curl returned HTTP 301; on node1, nft masquerade rule packet counters incremented and conntrack showed src=10.50.50.11/.12 dst=1.1.1.1 with reply src=1.1.1.1 dst=10.100.245.10 (node1's WAN IP), proving translation

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered NAT/config
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id=9028a473...; reboot acknowledged then connection timed out (node down); post-restart boot_id=3f82e72e... with uptime 0 min (changed identity); eth1 address, ip_forward, and NAT rule all persisted; NAT connectivity from node2 reverified working

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered config/connectivity
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id=1a816f1f...; reboot command closed the connection (ack before disconnect); post-restart boot_id=d9fb7456... with uptime 0 min; eth1 static IP persisted via ifcfg file; ping through node1's NAT succeeded again

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered config/connectivity
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id=bdbfa15c...; reboot command closed the connection (ack before disconnect); post-restart boot_id=0ebcb6c0... with uptime 0 min; eth1 static IP persisted; ping through node1's NAT succeeded again

selected_evidence.requirement: final end-state health of NAT gateway after all restarts
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart show nat confirms rule 10 still present; nft masquerade counter shows additional packets from the final verification pings, confirming NAT is actively translating traffic
